## Code

Everything public lives in one repository: [github.com/hungshinlee/NLP-LLM](https://github.com/hungshinlee/NLP-LLM) (the GitHub icon in the top-right corner goes there too).

- **Slides** — `slides/wNN.qmd`, rendered at [Slides](slides.qmd). They are Quarto reveal.js decks; the source is readable as Markdown.
- **The numbers on the slides** — `slides/assets/wNN/wNN-data.json`, one file per week (e.g. [`w02-data.json`](slides/assets/w02/w02-data.json)). Every measured figure on a deck — n-gram counts, Heaps' law fit, UTF-8 byte counts, the toy-corpus BPE merges, the compute ledger — is read from there, so a number you see can be traced to the file that produced it. The figures in `slides/assets/wNN/*.svg` are drawn from the same data.
- **Weekly pages** are generated from the course outline; the outline itself is not published.
- **In-class demos** are run live by the lecturer on the machine described above and are not part of this repository; you do not need to set anything up. Where a week has you watch a component being written from scratch (BPE in W2, for instance), the reference implementation is handed out after that session.

## Four Things This Course Admits It Does Not Know

These gaps are load-bearing rather than embarrassing — each is a project topic, and saying so is the honest graduate-level position.

- **W2** — there is no systematic study of tokenizer efficiency for Traditional Chinese, Taiwanese Hokkien, or Hakka; the only published numbers are incidental measurements in the technical reports of individual models. The fertility comparison is therefore measured live in class.
- **W12** — chunking and query rewriting have no citable representative papers; both are engineering folklore more than literature, so the course substitutes an ablation lab. RAG evaluation has fragmented, and nothing has become the accepted successor to RAGAS.
- **W13** — no textbook (JM3 ch 12 is unwritten), and no canonical design paper for the Model Context Protocol; its academic literature is almost entirely about security.
- **W14** — item response theory for benchmarks is still scattered; the text-side benchmarks for Taiwanese Hokkien and Hakka are effectively absent; and model welfare has no citable academic literature.
